title: Undertale: The Castle Far Off
alt: A dark cavern with small cold lights in its roof like stars. Far across a black lake stands a pale castle with pointed blue roofs and a few lit windows. Near us a wet ledge of blue-violet rock crosses the picture, and the water beside it shines blue-green. Two children stand on the ledge with their backs to us and look at the castle. One has brown hair and a blue jumper with two rose bands, and holds a rose umbrella over both. The other is a small yellow monster with points on its head, a striped shirt, no arms and a long tail. Blue flowers that give light grow in the dark grass at each side. Rain falls, and long pale falls of water come down at the far left.
summary: A painting of the view of the castle in Waterfall from Undertale in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is Waterfall, in Undertale, the game by Toby Fox. A human child has fallen into the land of the monsters, under a mountain. Here it rains from the roof of the cavern. The child has taken an umbrella, and a monster child walks under it too.

Far across the dark, the castle of the king comes into view. The lights overhead are crystals. The monsters cannot see the stars, so they make their wishes on these. The blue flowers are echo flowers, which say again the last thing that they heard. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
